artifacts.summary: Rabinovich formula analysis: maps Prop 3.5 to Lean code, identifies that all 4 sorries reduce to non-constant-env zone-matching, adversarial verification revealed K=0 base is NOT simpler than it appears, recommends EF-game/back-and-forth approach using Prior-UZ/SZ at semantic level

next_steps: Run /plan 303 to create implementation plan for the EF-game composition theorem on Prior structures

memory_candidates.content: Rabinovich 2014 Prop 3.5 translates exists-forall formulas to nested Until/Since with between-zone beta_j as the guard. The NF-based Lean formalization uses Top as the Until guard, losing between-zone information. This is the root cause of the Prior composition sorries in PriorComposition.lean.

On non-constant environments [x,t]/[x',t'], cross_extend_bwd_1var from h_x gives w'_x < x' with matching predicates, and from h_t gives w'_t > t' with matching predicates, but these are DIFFERENT witnesses. Unifying them into a single w' in (t', x') is the fundamental gap. Prior-UZ/SZ must be used at the semantic level (not via temporal truth) to avoid circularity with the completeness theorem being proved.

At K=0 in PriorComposition.lean (lines 322, 399), the sorry is INSIDE the construction of h_xt, not inside exist_transfer_3var_nonconstenv. This means hex_K is NOT available at K=0. The base case requires a direct depth-0 3-var transfer proof without any IH hypothesis, using only depth-1 1-var agreement plus Prior-UZ/SZ.
